title: Most Adults Cannot Pass This Medical Entrance Exam
summary: Explore Cells and Blood, Medicines and Microbes, Balance and Control, Structures and Signals, Science in Practice across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
From cells to whole systems.
How much can you connect?

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Cells and Blood, Medicines and Microbes, Balance and Control, Structures and Signals, Science in Practice. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a medical-school admission exam, professional qualification, diagnosis or medical advice.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.

medical-q3.question: Which organ is a major site for processing and breaking down many medicines?

medical-q4.question: Which statement best distinguishes viruses from bacteria?

answers.a1: A structure recognised by the immune system

answers.a1: Opposes a change from a regulated range
Net movement from higher to lower concentration

medical-q9.question: Which practice is a core part of preventing infection during patient care?

answers.a1: The complete absence of change in the body

medical-round5-new1.question: Why label a clinical sample accurately?

answers.a1: To connect the result to the correct patient and sample
answers.a4: To conceal when it was collected

medical-round5-new2.question: What is a control group used for in a study?
